vulnerability.name: USN-5034-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5034-1 fixed a vulnerability in c-ares. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Philipp Jeitner and Haya Shulman discovered that c-ares incorrectly  validated certain hostnames returned by DNS servers. A remote attacker  could possibly use this issue to perform Domain Hijacking attacks.

statements.status_notes: c-ares could be made to return wrong domains. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
